windows.text: Lorna came in out of the rain and shook her coat. She asked for the usual and Mark poured it without a word.
Lorna drank slowly and watched the door. She had the look of someone who expected a letter.
Mark told him it was an old burn. Lorna said it was a hand, and that she could see the fingers.
In the district everyone knew Lorna, and nobody had a bad word for Lorna.
